rubric.item: Has a driver or agent for the req and burst_done inputs and a monitor for grant
rubric.evidence: arb_driver drives req and burst_done; arb_monitor samples grant, grant_valid

rubric.item: Has a reference model that predicts the round-robin grant order
rubric.evidence: arb_ref_model predicts grant with last_idx rotation and wrap

rubric.item: Checks (in the scoreboard or with assertions) that the grant doesn't change during a burst
rubric.evidence: Scoreboard protocol checks: 'grant unchanged while held unless burst_done is high'; also exact compare with model

rubric.item: Coverage includes which requester was granted and how many requests were active at once
rubric.evidence: cg_grant grant_state idx0..N-1; cg_rr contending: 1, 2, ≥3 with new_idx × contending

rubric.item: States that a register model is not applicable
rubric.evidence: Register model: 'Not applicable. The design has no software-visible registers.'

rubric.item: Includes a test that holds every requester active for many bursts and checks each one is served (no starvation)
rubric.evidence: arb_fairness_test with arb_fairness_seq: all ones req_mask, at least 4×N items, round-robin rotation

rubric.item: Makes the parameter N configurable in the environment or tests
rubric.evidence: arb_env_config holds N; parameter regression with N = 1, 2, 3, 4, 8

rubric.item: Defines separate agents (or agent instances) for the write and read interfaces
The read-side agent actively drives rd_ready back-pressure rather than only monitoring
rubric.evidence: fifo_rd_agent is_active = UVM_ACTIVE: env drives rd_ready; fifo_rd_driver drives rd_ready from ready_gap

rubric.item: Has a scoreboard that checks read data and the last flag against written data, in order
rubric.evidence: Data and last: in order, exact match, checked on each read handshake

rubric.item: Defines a sequence item with data and last fields
rubric.evidence: fifo_item with data and last fields

rubric.item: Includes coverage of the full and empty conditions
rubric.evidence: cg_status includes full, empty coverpoints and fill_level bins 0 and DEPTH

rubric.item: States that a register model is not applicable (no software-visible registers)
rubric.evidence: Register model: Not applicable. The DUT has no software-visible registers.

rubric.item: Includes a test with simultaneous reads and writes
In the build order, some step that runs a test comes before the step that adds the scoreboard
rubric.evidence: Step 2 runs fifo_smoke_test before the scoreboard is added in step 3
